W: Hi, Tom. It’s Sue. I need your help for Luke’s birthday. M: Okay, Sue. What can I do for you? W: I don’t know what to buy for his birthday. Did you buy a present for him? M: Yes. I bought a baseball glove for him. W: Oh, you already did. What should I buy for him? I don’t have any idea. M: Well, he likes playing baseball these days. Why don’t you buy him a baseball? W: Good idea! Where can I buy a baseball? M; ABC sports shop near school. Maybe you can find a nice baseball there. W: Okay, thanks!
